blocks.x: EUDR due-diligence automated — compliance evidence in hours, premium channels opened

A global coffee trader — a Agriculture & Food Systems engagement delivered by a blended Dataq Software team under the outcome-linked engagement model. Identity withheld as standard; the figures are the client's, reproduced with permission.
EUDR geolocation evidence assembled manually per lot; customs risk.
Provenance claims unverifiable; premium buyers skeptical. Custody events paper-based across origin chain.

The chain-of-custody network anchors plot geolocation and custody events from farm to port with verifiable credentials for participants; regulator and buyer verification interfaces serve scoped evidence; and the traceability spine answers due-diligence queries in hours with cryptographic provenance.

items: the shared record was governed and verifiable, so every participant's auditors could walk the same trail.
edge processing put decisions where the data was born; the round trips disappeared from the process.
the data spine was certified once and reused everywhere, which is why the numbers held up under audit.
